issues.title: Export: filter tasks with --since
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Let `tasklet export --since 2026-01-01` export only tasks created on or after a date.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `--since <date>` limits exported rows to tasks created on or after the date.
- An invalid date exits with status 2 and an error message.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/export.py`
- `tasklet/cli.py`
- `tests/test_export.py`

issues.title: Refactor storage handle
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

`Store` owns both the task file and the output stream. Split the stream out into a separate writer interface that `terminal.py` and `export.py` take as an argument, so storage owns only the task file.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `Store` no longer holds an output stream.
- `terminal` and `export` receive the writer as an argument.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/storage.py`
- `tasklet/terminal.py`

issues.title: Follow-up to #11: tidy terminal output
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

`tasklet export > tasks.csv` and `tasklet export` in CI crash with `RuntimeError: no terminal`, because `terminal.output_stream` requires a TTY on the storage handle's stream. Export to a file, the main use of the export core feature, does not work at all until this is fixed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `tasklet export > tasks.csv` writes the CSV and exits 0.
- `tasklet export` in a non-interactive shell writes the CSV to stdout.

## Dependencies

Blocked by #11: the fix needs the output stream split out of the storage handle.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/terminal.py`
- `tasklet/export.py`
